open_issues.summary: Spawn-to-Alpha traversal is below the 30–45 second contract

blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore a grounded 30–45 second deployment-to-Alpha route on the intact authored environment and make the existing boot/input behavior retain sufficient candidate-owned state for deterministic same-session mouse-look verification, while preserving clean boot, fixed-spawn F6 behavior, reload-only R, map ownership, and all accepted combat foundations.

diagnosis.root_cause: The arena binds deployment near the map origin and Alpha only about one short navigation leg away, then accepts connectivity and clearance without validating route length or traversal time; prior ordinary-input evidence therefore reaches Alpha in approximately 9.1 seconds instead of 30–45. Separately, mouse-look behavior already records correct yaw/pitch changes, but runtime state exposes only the latest receipt rather than a generation-bounded sequence proving independent horizontal and vertical inputs in one uninterrupted gameplay run. The repeated bootstrap failure is therefore an evidence-retention defect, not a reason to retune camera motion.

stop_conditions: Stop if satisfying the route budget would require moving or editing authored child meshes, duplicating the environment, adding proxy floors, throttling player speed, or inserting artificial delays.
Stop and report the measured navigation bounds if no collision-backed pair of native walkable spawn/Alpha anchors can satisfy the route budget without leaving the accepted map.
Stop the runtime pass after any stateful MCP request with an unknown outcome; GameLoop Runtime must reconcile or rebind before the complete scenario is replayed.
Do not hand off if clean boot regresses, the authored environment has more than one runtime instance, F6 no longer restores deployment spawn, or R triggers anything other than reload.

strategy.rationale: Use product-owned anchor restoration on the existing authored navigation topology instead of transform micro-tuning or artificial timing. For the twice-treated MCP coverage issue, preserve the working look implementation and add bounded, generation-aware observation receipts so Tester can recapture the required causal sequence without relying on a single transient state.

code: Load and parse the project with no new GDScript, resource, or scene errors; retain the frozen clean-boot baseline.

Inspect route-binding invariants: exactly one authored environment instance, unchanged authored child transforms, native navigation/collision ownership, valid spawn and Alpha occupancy, and a latched route result.

Exercise receipt serialization and reset boundaries so history stays bounded, ordered, generation-tagged, and contains distinct horizontal and vertical before/after values without changing camera math.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime and Tester must recapture a fresh title-to-deployment run, then time ordinary movement from fixed spawn to the first legal Alpha overlap; require 30–45 seconds, high grounded ratio, no persistent collision stall, and one latched completion.

In the same unpaused gameplay generation, Tester must capture state before/after isolated horizontal mouse input and before/after isolated vertical input, verifying yaw-only then pitch-only causal changes from distinct receipt IDs.

Repeat the fixed control smoke: W/A/S/D press-hold-release and stop, jump/ground recovery, Escape pause/resume with input recapture, R reload-only, and F6 fixed deployment reset before and after checkpoint creation.
Collect editor/runtime error logs after route traversal, F6 reset, pause/resume, and the mouse-look sequence; clean boot and lifecycle state must remain error-free.
visual: Capture first-person frames at fixed spawn, a mid-route exterior approach, and Alpha entry plus one overhead scene/navigation view; verify native streets and structures provide grounding, turns, landmark hierarchy, and no void, roof spawn, proxy floor, or near-clip objective obstruction.

Capture at least two distinct in-sequence gameplay frames paired with the horizontal and vertical look receipts at 1280×720; the world view must visibly respond while the HUD, reticle, and gameplay state remain coherent.
Compare spawn framing before and after F6 using the same camera framing; require the same safe native-surface anchor and no map, weapon, HUD, or material regression.

done_when: A fresh deployment binds spawn and Alpha to collision-backed native walkable surfaces in one accepted topology transaction, with the intact authored environment remaining the sole map instance.

Ordinary direct traversal from fixed spawn to the first legal Alpha overlap measures 30–45 seconds under the normal controller, with no artificial wait, speed reduction, proxy geometry, collision escape, or persistent stall.

The route report identifies the mission generation, first movement, first Alpha overlap, elapsed/effective time, traveled distance, ordered navigation corners, grounded ratio, and collision/stall state.
F6 starts a fresh route measurement at the same fixed deployment anchor, while checkpoint restoration remains distinct and cannot fabricate a compliant route time.
Spawn, approach, and Alpha remain spatially readable through native streets, turns, structures, and landmarks; Alpha is not exposed as a short straight approach from deployment.
tasks.instructions: Restore deployment-to-Alpha layout through the product-owned anchor binding around the preserved authored environment. Replace the current near-origin/near-Alpha pairing with deterministic selection and validation of native walkable spawn and Alpha anchors whose actual collision-backed navigation route produces the required 30–45 second effective traversal and a meaningful change of sightline. Bind spawn, Alpha, navigation, collision, and objective volume in the existing topology transaction; keep every authored map child and transform intact. Do not use proxy surfaces, extracted geometry, player-speed changes, invisible blockers, timed gates, or delay zones. Extend the route probe so a fresh mission or F6 reset begins a generation-tagged measurement and the first legal Alpha overlap latches one result rather than continuing or being overwritten.
tasks.title: Restore the native spawn-to-Alpha route budget

done_when: Runtime state retains a bounded, ordered look-receipt history for the current deployment generation, including event identity, input source/raw axis, before/after yaw and pitch, applied deltas, and gameplay/capture eligibility.
A fresh deployment or F6 reset creates an unambiguous observation boundary without changing mouse sensitivity, pitch limits, input authority, or the accepted camera response.
One uninterrupted unpaused gameplay sequence can distinguish horizontal-only yaw change and vertical-only pitch change from the retained receipts and paired frames.
Existing keyboard/mouse and gamepad look paths remain functional, R remains reload-only, and F6 remains fixed-spawn reset rather than checkpoint mutation.
tasks.instructions: Repair the repeated bootstrap evidence gap with candidate-owned observation state, not another camera transform or sensitivity adjustment. Preserve the current look calculations and expose a bounded, ordered, deployment-generation-aware history of accepted look receipts through the player runtime state. Each receipt must contain enough before/after information to prove whether horizontal or vertical input caused the corresponding yaw or pitch change, plus input source, raw axis, capture/gameplay eligibility, and a stable sequence marker. Reset or retag the observation window on fresh deployment and F6 so old inputs cannot satisfy a new run. Keep this instrumentation passive and free of tester-only shortcuts or gameplay mutations.
tasks.title: Retain causal mouse-look evidence across one run
